Title: Return and Refund Policy
Content: Customers may request a return if the product is defective, damaged, or does not match the description. Returns must be initiated within 7 days of delivery. Products must be unused, in original condition, and include all packaging and accessories. Non-returnable items include perishable goods, personalized items, hygiene products, and final sale items. Once the returned product is received and inspected, refunds will be processed within 5–7 business days to the original payment method. Shipping charges are non-refundable unless the return is due to our error.

Title: Shipping Policy
Content: Orders are processed within 24–48 hours. Delivery timelines are typically 3–7 business days for domestic orders and 7–15 business days for international shipments. Shipping charges are calculated at checkout based on location, weight, and shipping method. Customers will receive tracking details after dispatch. Delays may occur due to weather, logistics, or customs. We are not responsible for delays caused by external factors.

Title: Product Policy
Content: We strive to ensure all product descriptions, images, and prices are accurate. However, slight variations may occur due to display differences or manufacturing updates. Product availability may change without notice. We reserve the right to cancel orders in case of pricing errors or stock issues. Customers are responsible for reviewing product details before purchasing.

Title: Damaged and Defective Policy
Content: If a product arrives damaged or defective, customers must notify us within 48 hours of delivery. Clear photos or videos must be provided as proof. The product must be kept in original packaging for inspection. We will offer a replacement or full refund based on the situation. Claims made after 48 hours may not be accepted.

Title: Warranty Policy
Content: Certain products come with a manufacturer or seller warranty. Warranty periods vary by product and cover only manufacturing defects. Warranty does not cover physical damage, misuse, normal wear and tear, or unauthorized repairs. To claim warranty, customers must provide proof of purchase and evidence of the issue. Further instructions will be provided after claim verification.

Title: Cancellation Policy
Content: Orders can be cancelled before shipment. Once shipped, orders cannot be cancelled and must go through the return process. Refunds for cancelled orders are processed within 5 business days.

Title: Payment Policy
Content: We accept payments via credit cards, debit cards, net banking, UPI, and digital wallets. Orders are processed only after successful payment. In case of payment failure, the order will not be confirmed.

Title: Privacy Policy
Content: We respect customer privacy and ensure that personal information is used only for order processing, communication, and service improvement. We do not sell or share personal data with third parties without consent, except as required by law.

Title: Terms of Service
Content: By using our services, customers agree to comply with our policies and terms. We reserve the right to update our policies at any time without prior notice. Continued use of our services after changes constitutes acceptance of the new policies.
